title: Agentic RSR: Real-to-Sim-to-Real through Scene Reconstruction and Execution-Grounded Robot Policies
abstract: A simulation of a real robot workspace must preserve task-relevant interactions, while policies developed in it must operate on observations available to the real robot. Yet scene reconstruction and policy development are often treated separately. We present Agentic Real-to-Sim-to-Real (Agentic RSR), a framework that links scene reconstruction, policy development, and real-robot execution through the same manipulation task. Given a workspace video, a task description, and a known robot model, an agent recovers metric scale, iteratively refines the scene using visual feedback, and checks task-relevant interactions in MuJoCo. A coding agent then develops an executable policy, progressing from privileged object poses to visual observations and randomized simulation. The policy can interleave multiple observations and actions within one invocation, while the agent uses execution feedback to continue, retry, or revise its approach. A shared task-level interface carries the policy and accumulated experience to the real robot, where fresh observations and safety checks guide execution. Using Claude Opus 5.5 through DeepSeek Harness (DSH), all 18 scenes across two robots pass the joint visual check; mean four-view Depth MAE against reference depth estimates is 0.0808 m, mean Lab $ΔE_{76}$ is 8.01, and mean grayscale SSIM is 0.7338. In real-robot experiments, the aggregate task success rate reaches 80% of the simulation task success rate, indicating substantial retention of simulated performance on hardware. Code and reconstructed scene data will be made publicly available.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 exact version 2610.10479v2 的 26 页全文与关键图表核验。实验数字与比较均为作者报告，本项目未独立复现。代码状态：promised。 本次实质更新：从Codex reconstruction迁DSH，新Table3八model/18scene batch、主指标改0.08078/8.0104/0.73375；旧Codex/objectmetrics分离附录、policy结果不变。
analysis.ideaZh: Agentic RSR v2 将scene planning/refinement/physics迁到DSH并新增8种model的18-scene评测，主配置Claude Opus5.5作者报告18/18 joint-visual passes、DepthMAE0.08078m/Lab8.0104/SSIM0.73375。旧Codex与object-metrics保留独立附录；不能把改善归因模型或harness，policy8/18 real successes未变。作为实质experiment更新skim收录。
analysis.motivationZh: real workspace的visual/metric reconstruction与可执行policy/realrobot验证常分离，缺统一task-level loop。
analysis.methodZh: known URDF与VGGT/SAM robot cloud经Sim3恢复metric frame，四reference cameras/robot冻结；agent以RGB和scalar depth/color feedback编辑Blender candidate，程序joint acceptance后编译MuJoCo并probe physical hypotheses。三pass code policy从privileged到visual再randomized，固定evaluation policy与experience transfer。v2新增DSH/backendbatch与独立provenance，不是纯versionstamp。
analysis.experimentsZh: 18task scenes、Franka/Piper各9，四reference views；新8DSH configs，六有scene metrics全18denominator。Opus/多数models五轮，Fablebudget未知；policy随机sim/real录次沿用旧。 以下结果为作者报告：作者新Opus DSH报告18/18passes、first joint round2.22、DepthMAE0.08078m/Lab8.0104/SSIM0.73375。（Tables2–3 pp.7–8）；作者Fable18/18、MAE0.07326；Astra15/18，Sonnet15/18，Sol12/18，GPT5.6Sol4/18；Kimi/DeepSeek无法完成tool workflow。（Table3 p.8）；作者旧policy仍Sim10/18、Real8/18、paired80%；不是新改善。（Table4 p.9） 对照范围：Re3Sim/RLGSBridge/RoboSimGS/SimFoundry reconstruction旧baseline未重跑；新增modelcomparisons只固定DSH，跨harnessbudget不匹配。CaP真实任务与indexedtasks非完全匹配。 消融与诊断：oldCodex去metricfeedback/initialcalibration与model-swap保留AppendixC，不能当DSH ablation；新DSH没有组件matched ablation或objectgeometry测量。
analysis.insightZh: 原创新是reconstruction→programmatic policy→execution闭环；本次新增harness/backend数据并澄清batch/provenance，不是新算法。8-model实测与newscene quality有实质实验delta。
analysis.evidenceZh: v2更换reconstruction harness为DSH、主modelOpus5.5，physics修改后保持四view regression。（Sec.3.1 pp.4–5; AppendixD pp.18–23）；作者报告Opus/Fable18/18、GPT-Astra15/18、Sol12/18等DSH结果。（Table3 p.8; Sec.4.3 pp.7–8）；旧Codexbatch/objectmetrics被明确保留分离，crossbatch不能isolated attribution。（AppendixC pp.15–17; Sec.4.3 p.8）；真实policy transfer80%仍只是8/10sim-success任务，real完成8/18。（Table4 p.9）
analysis.whyRelevantZh: scene design agent操作并验证可执行3D assets；新backend/harness数据对agent workflow可靠性判断有直接价值。
analysis.caveatZh: closedmodel接口/设备/时间variability未经受控测量；modelcall/checkpoint延迟限制快速contact（p.9）。；depthreference来自VGGT非independentGT；视觉pass不代表真实physical参数或task可行性。；新旧harness、model和roundbudget同时变化；不能据aggregate表建立general model ranking。；未公开implementation/scene数据，DSH per-scene/objectmetrics不足；所有数值为作者报告。
